prd_sections.title: Overview
prd_sections.summary: Canonical actor model for identity, inheritance, and personalization in Lupopedia.

prd_sections.title: Department-First Actor Model
prd_sections.summary: Actors belong to departments, not individual users, with act-as eligibility based on department intersection.

prd_sections.title: Three-Layer Identity and Lifecycle
prd_sections.summary: Defines auth user, actor, and agent layers plus actor lifecycle and seed-to-canonical mapping.

prd_sections.title: Workspace and Learning Boundaries
prd_sections.summary: Specifies actor workspace structure, context files, and constrained learning process.

prd_sections.title: Memory Doctrine Addendum
prd_sections.summary: Applies edge dimensions, status semantics, and required review_reason for needs_review.

prd_rules.summary: User act-as eligibility is department intersection based, not single-user actor ownership.
Auth users authenticate, actors orchestrate, agents provide templates; do not conflate layers.
Low seed actor IDs map deterministically to canonical living actor IDs when instantiated.
Actor workspace directories and core files must follow canonical structure and attribution rules.
Memory edges with needs_review status require explicit review_reason for routing.

definitions.meaning: Runtime persona that executes work under department-scoped context.
Immutable filesystem-defined definition under lupo-agents used by actors.
Department-authorized selection of actor persona by authenticated user.
Low registry ID reserved for install and doctrine reference identities.
Deterministic living actor ID used for runtime memory, edges, and sessions.
